nodes.description: The store NAMED in the request decides for every user: Use global (or unset) follows the global setting, Enabled challenges, Disabled lets the sign-in through — customers and Managers alike. A request with no or an unknown storeId follows the global setting; the Backoffice follows the global setting only. The user's own store is not consulted.
nodes.notes: Reconciled 2026-10-28 (DRIFT raised by the VCST-5904 test model): the rev-2 SPEC note above, from the vc-module-mfa#1 PR body, said a store relaxes the global setting only for its own customers and that the user's own store is also consulted. Comment 112278, MfaRequirementService and the promoted cases say the named store decides for every user. The deployed StoreMode description said otherwise (VCST-6530) and was reworded on the final build (round 2 C31).
